text: I woke up at seven and got out of bed.
meaning: 我七点醒来并起床。

text: She ate breakfast and drank a cup of tea.
meaning: 她吃了早餐并喝了一杯茶。

text: He sat by the window and stood up to leave.
meaning: 他坐在窗边，站起来离开。

text: I lay on the sofa, then laid my keys on the table.
meaning: 我躺在沙发上，然后把钥匙放在桌上。

text: She put the milk in the fridge and shut the door.
meaning: 她把牛奶放进冰箱并关上门。

text: He set the table and lit a candle.
meaning: 他摆好桌子并点燃蜡烛。

text: I fed the cat, and it bit my hand.
meaning: 我喂了猫，它咬了我的手。

text: I awoke early, slept well, and felt great.
meaning: 我醒得早，睡得好，感觉很好。

text: I went to work, and Mia came with me.
meaning: 我去上班，Mia 和我一起。

text: She left early and led the team to the airport.
meaning: 她早早出发，带领团队去机场。

text: He rode a bike, and I drove the car.
meaning: 他骑自行车，我开汽车。

text: We flew to Japan and swam in the sea.
meaning: 我们飞往日本并在海里游泳。

text: The sun rose, and the sky became bright.
meaning: 太阳升起，天空变亮了。

text: A problem arose, so he leaped into action.
meaning: 问题出现了，所以他立刻行动。

text: He sped up, slid on the ice, and fell down.
meaning: 他加速、在冰上滑行然后摔倒。

text: The boat sank, and the news spread fast.
meaning: 船沉了，消息传得很快。

text: I saw the answer and knew it at once.
meaning: 我看到答案，立刻就明白了。

text: She heard the news and thought about it.
meaning: 她听到消息并思考了一下。

text: He understood the question but forgot the answer.
meaning: 他理解了问题但忘了答案。

text: I learned a new word and taught it to Ben.
meaning: 我学了一个新词并教给了 Ben。

text: She read the book and wrote a report.
meaning: 她读了这本书并写了一篇报告。

text: He spelled the word, and I found the meaning.
meaning: 他拼出这个词，我找到了含义。

text: The flowers smelled sweet, and I felt happy.
meaning: 花闻起来很香，我感觉很开心。

text: I dreamed about the test, and it meant a lot.
meaning: 我梦到考试，这对我意义重大。

text: She said hello and told me the news.
meaning: 她打了招呼并告诉我这个消息。

text: He spoke slowly and sang a song.
meaning: 他说得很慢并唱了一首歌。

text: The phone rang, and I held it to my ear.
meaning: 电话响了，我把它放到耳边。

text: They broadcast the news, but he swore it was a lie.
meaning: 他们播报了新闻，但他发誓那是假的。

text: She forbade me to go, but later forgave me.
meaning: 她禁止我去，但后来原谅了我。

text: He sent a message and brought a gift.
meaning: 他发了一条消息并带来一份礼物。

text: I met Ben, and he showed me around.
meaning: 我见了 Ben，他带我参观。

text: She gave me the file, and I bore the cost.
meaning: 她给了我文件，我承担了费用。

text: I bought a phone and sold my old one.
meaning: 我买了一部手机并卖掉了旧的。

text: She paid the bill, and it cost a lot.
meaning: 她付了账单，花了很多钱。

text: He spent too much, so he lent me some money.
meaning: 他花得太多，所以借给我一些钱。

text: I took the money and made a small bet.
meaning: 我拿了钱并打了一个小赌。

text: She dealt with the problem and quit arguing.
meaning: 她处理了问题并停止争论。

text: He chose the best deal and won a prize.
meaning: 他选择了最好的交易并赢了一个奖。

text: Someone stole my bag, and I lost everything.
meaning: 有人偷了我的包，我失去了一切。

text: We made a deal, and both sides were happy.
meaning: 我们达成协议，双方都很满意。

text: He ran fast and threw the ball.
meaning: 他跑得很快并扔出了球。

text: She caught the ball and hit it hard.
meaning: 她接住球并用力击打。

text: Our team beat them in the final match.
meaning: 我们队在决赛中打败了他们。

text: They fought hard and won the game.
meaning: 他们奋力拼搏并赢得了比赛。

text: He shot the ball, but it struck the post.
meaning: 他射门，但球击中了门柱。

text: She swung the bat and spun around.
meaning: 她挥动球棒并旋转了一圈。

text: They hid the ball and hung the net.
meaning: 他们把球藏起来并挂好网。

text: They fought, ran, and beat every team.
meaning: 他们战斗、奔跑，击败了所有队伍。

text: I hurt my leg, and it bled a lot.
meaning: 我伤了腿，流了很多血。

text: She burned her hand and cut her finger.
meaning: 她烫伤了手并割伤了手指。

text: He broke his arm, and the balloon burst.
meaning: 他摔断了手臂，气球也爆了。

text: A bee stung me, so I spat and shook my hand.
meaning: 蜜蜂蜇了我，所以我吐了口唾沫并甩了甩手。

text: He split the milk and tore his shirt.
meaning: 他打翻了牛奶并撕破了衬衫。

text: The water froze, and my clothes shrank.
meaning: 水结冰了，我的衣服缩水了。

text: He bent down, knelt, and leaned on the table.
meaning: 他弯下腰，跪下，倚靠在桌子上。

text: I spilled the coffee on the floor.
meaning: 我把咖啡洒在地板上。

text: I had a bike, and I did my best to keep it.
meaning: 我有一辆自行车，我尽力保存它。

text: She let me try, and I built a model.
meaning: 她让我尝试，我建了一个模型。

text: He drew a map, and my garden grew well.
meaning: 他画了一张地图，我的花园长得很好。

text: The wind blew, and the rope wound around the pole.
meaning: 风吹过，绳子缠绕在杆子上。

text: She dug a hole and bound the wood with rope.
meaning: 她挖了一个坑，用绳子把木头捆起来。

text: He wore a hat and swept the floor, and the dust stuck to his shoes.
meaning: 他戴着帽子扫地，灰尘粘在了鞋上。

text: The sun shone, and it was a beautiful day.
meaning: 阳光照耀，那是美好的一天。

text: The milk spoiled, so I began to clean it up.
meaning: 牛奶坏了，所以我开始清理。
